output_list.reason: Integer overflow in withdrawFunds function allows owner to withdraw funds from contract, the balance of contract is also affected.
Integer overflow in multiTransfer function allows owner to transfer funds to multiple addresses, the balance of owner is also affected.
Integer overflow in transferFrom function allows owner to transfer funds from one address to another, the balance of owner is also affected.
Integer overflow in approve function allows owner to set the balance of an address by the value of another.
Integer overflow in setupAirDrop function allows owner to set the balance of contract by a boolean value.
